Emmitt Smith

Emmitt James Smith III  (Scoey)

Position: RB

5-9, 221lb (175cm, 100kg)

Born: May 15, 1969 in Pensacola, FL

College: Florida  (College Stats)

Weighted Career AV (100-95-...): 129 (28th overall since 1960)

High School: Escambia (FL)

Draft: Dallas Cowboys in the 1st round (17th overall) of the 1990 NFL Draft.

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2010 (Full List)

Twitter: @EmmittSmith22  · Instagram: emmittsmith22

  • Hall of Fame
  • 8x Pro Bowl
  • 4x All-Pro
  • 3x SB Champ
  • 1993 AP MVP
  • 2x NEA MVP
  • 1993 PFWA MVP

  • HOF All-1990s Team

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Emmitt Smith?

Emmitt Smith is 55 years old.

When was Emmitt Smith born?

Emmitt Smith was born on May 15, 1969.

Where was Emmitt Smith born?

Emmitt Smith was born in Pensacola, FL.

How tall is Emmitt Smith?

Emmitt Smith is 5-9 (175 cm) tall.

How much did Emmitt Smith weigh when playing?

Emmitt Smith weighed 221 lbs (100 kg) when playing.

Is Emmitt Smith in the Hall of Fame?

Emmitt Smith was elected into the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2010.

How many games did Emmitt Smith play?

Emmitt Smith played 226 games over his career.

How many rushing attempts did Emmitt Smith have?

Emmitt Smith had 4,409 rushing attempts over his career.

How many rushing yards did Emmitt Smith have?

Emmitt Smith had 18,355 rushing yards over his career.

How many Super Bowls has Emmitt Smith won?

Emmitt Smith has won 3 Super Bowls.

When did Emmitt Smith retire?

Emmitt Smith last played in 2004.

What is Emmitt Smith's Twitter account?

Emmitt Smith is on Twitter at EmmittSmith22.

What is Emmitt Smith's Instagram account?

Emmitt Smith is on Instagram at emmittsmith22.

What are Emmitt Smith's nicknames?

Scoey is a nickname for Emmitt Smith.
